purpose: The organizational half of SOC 2 CC1-CC9: the controls that code and tenant configuration cannot evidence on their own. This register records the STRUCTURE those controls need -- owner, cadence, evidence, reviewer, retention -- and does not assert that any of them operates.
relationship_to_the_crosswalk: Deliberately a separate artifact from engine/mappings/soc2/common-criteria/v1.0.0/mapping.json. That file's SHA-256 is pinned into every scan at creation and covered by the Phase 3 immutability trigger, so adding organizational fields to it would change the mapping digest of every future scan and desynchronise it from every historical scan's pinned snapshot. This register carries no rating and cannot influence one.
counted_in_automated_coverage_note: Structural, not advisory. Organizational assurance must never enter the automated compliance or coverage arithmetic, which Phase 3 defined over selected CIS controls only. The same guarantee is expressed as a Literal[False] field in backend-api/app/schemas/soc2.py.

approval.note: No owner in this register is assigned, because none has been appointed. Phase 0 decisions D01-D10 remain unapproved drafts with no named owners, recorded identically in the Phase 7, 8 and 9 handoffs. Engineering has no authority to name a control owner, and a register populated with guessed owners would be worse than an empty one: it would read as accountability that does not exist.

retention.note: An engineering label bound to an unapproved policy, following the phase7-draft-1 and phase8-draft-1 precedent. Phase 0 decision D04 governs retention, states that it is not a legal minimum or an existing product commitment, and states that no automatic cleanup is authorized by it. Nothing enforces any period.

operating_status_vocabulary.not_designed: No artifact and no procedure exists.
operating_status_vocabulary.designed_not_operating: An artifact exists in the repository that would evidence this control if it were run and reviewed on a cadence. No execution record exists.
operating_status_vocabulary.operating: Executed on its cadence with retained records and a named reviewer. NOTHING in this register is in this state, and nothing may be moved into it by an engineering change.
